claim: Source/version/location provenance that was never captured when commercial truth was created cannot be reliably reconstructed later from the final value alone.
source_locator: Phase 1 Structure Audit v1 + accepted roadmap principle on evidence/provenance
notes: Internal architecture reasoning: the constraint is adopted because retrofit cannot recreate missing historical provenance, not because competitors use it.

claim: A future agent can safely invoke deterministic business behavior only if state-changing behavior is exposed through bounded validated actions rather than arbitrary database mutation; otherwise the action surface must be rebuilt before autonomous use.
source_locator: Phase 1 Structure Audit v1 + accepted roadmap principle on bounded actions
notes: Internal architecture reasoning: bounded actions are a low-cost non-retrofittable interface constraint independent of whether advanced AI succeeds.
